title: Risk Management
description: PAT inventory and secret findings — GitHub PAT policy + Secret Scanning

options.content:
## 🔑 Personal Access Tokens
Inventário de PATs via GitHub Fine-Grained PAT API (requer org policy habilitada).

panels.title: Total de PATs
panels.description: PATs ativos descobertos via org API. Zero indica que a org não tem fine-grained PAT policy habilitada (conta pessoal).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_github_pat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> last()

panels.title: PATs sem Expiração
panels.description: PATs sem data de expiração configurada — risco de tokens permanentes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_github_pat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "no_expiration")
  |> last()

panels.title: PATs Expirando em 7 dias
panels.description: PATs com expiração iminente — requerem renovação urgente.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_github_pat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "expiring_7d")
  |> last()

panels.title: API PAT Disponível
panels.description: Indica se a GitHub Org PAT API está acessível. false = conta pessoal ou policy não habilitada.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_github_pat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.available == "true" then 1 else 0}))

options.content:
## 🔓 Secret Scanning
Findings via GitHub Secret Scanning API. Requer `security_events` scope no token e secret scanning habilitado no repositório.

panels.title: Findings por Severidade
panels.description: Distribuição atual de findings abertos por severidade.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_gitleaks_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "critical" or r._field == "high" or r._field == "medium" or r._field == "low")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r._field}))

panels.title: Total Findings Abertos
panels.description: Soma de todos os findings abertos de secret scanning.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_gitleaks_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> last()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Findings Críticos
panels.description: Findings com severidade critical — chaves AWS, GCP, Azure, GitHub PATs, chaves privadas.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_gitleaks_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "critical")
  |> last()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Secret Scanning Disponível
panels.description: Indica se a GitHub Secret Scanning API está acessível. false = token sem scope security_events ou feature não habilitada.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_gitleaks_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.available == "true" then 1 else 0}))

panels.title: Trend de Findings (últimos 30d)
panels.description: Evolução do total de findings ao longo do tempo. Queda indica remediação; alta indica novos segredos expostos.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_gitleaks_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "critical" or r._field == "high")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r._field}))

panels.title: Findings por Repositório
panels.description: Contagem de findings por repo e severidade — prioriza remediação.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "governance_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gov_gitleaks_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total" or r._field == "critical" or r._field == "high")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["repo", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["repo"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["total"], desc: true)
